title: How a fishing town became the Riviera
episode: #51 - How the French Riviera became popular!
description: How the coast around Nice turned into a winter resort for the British in the 1700s and 1800s, and later into a summer one. English residents paid for the first seaside path in the 1820s, which is why it is called the Promenade des Anglais.

title: The Rolling Stones’ summer in a Riviera villa
episode: Geir Hornes - The Curious Chronicles of Villa Nellcote
description: Author Geir Hornes on Villa Nellcôte, the mansion above the bay of Villefranche, just east of Nice, where Keith Richards lived in 1971 and the Rolling Stones recorded much of Exile on Main St. in the basement.

title: Writers on the Riviera
episode: Famous writers and the French Riviera
description: Author John Baxter on writers who lived on the Riviera, especially F. Scott Fitzgerald, who spent summers on the coast west of Nice in the 1920s. He and Zelda rented the villa at Juan-les-Pins that is now the Hôtel Belles Rives.

title: Matisse stays put in wartime Nice
episode: Christopher C. Gorham, "Matisse at War: Art and Resistance in Nazi Occupied France" (Citadel Press, 2025)
description: Christopher Gorham on why Henri Matisse, ill and newly divorced, stayed in Nice when the Germans arrived in 1940, while his family joined the Resistance. The museum in Cimiez, near his apartment, holds the works he left the city.

title: The chapel Matisse called his masterpiece
episode: Matisse's Stations of the Cross in Vence
description: Art historian Yve-Alain Bois on the drawings Matisse made for the Stations of the Cross in the Rosary Chapel at Vence, in the hills above Nice. Matisse designed everything in the chapel, from the stained glass to the priests’ robes.

title: Chagall, remembered by his granddaughter
episode: Marc Chagall: Reflections of a Granddaughter
description: Bella Meyer on her grandfather Marc Chagall, his letters, and his ties to Yiddish culture. Chagall spent his last decades near Nice, and he helped design the museum that opened here in 1973 for his paintings of the Bible.
